prompt: Which architect was tasked with finishing the chapel in the newly built Papal apartment when its construction remained incomplete after Pope Paul IV moved in, in October 1556?
answer: Pirro Ligorio was tasked with finishing the chapel in the newly built Papal apartment after Pope Paul IV moved in during October 1556.
